title: Chapter 230: Inner Court Mentor
content:
Chapter 230: Inner Court Mentor

In this way, Xiao Yin officially became a tutor in the inner courtyard of Tiandi Academy, with a noble status.

An Lingyun took out a ring and handed it to Xiao Yin.

Inside are the costumes and tokens of the instructor of the inner courtyard of Tiandi Academy.

After Xiao Yin took the ring, An Lingyun didn't say anything, but just glanced at Lu Xue and left here.

Stand where you are.

Lu Xue approached Xiao Yin's side and asked curiously: "Is that old man really the dean?"

It doesn't seem special.

Lu Xue thought that the dean of a force like Tiandi Academy was a great scholar with a bookish atmosphere.

As a result, it was actually a street sweeper. . .

Hearing this, Xiao Yin nodded.

"Since I first entered the academy, he has been the dean of the Tiandi Academy."

"But he hasn't made any decisions about the academy for a long time."

This sentence is very meaningful, and Lu Xue still didn't react, while Xiao Luo, who was standing beside him, was shocked and said, "Sister Yin, do you mean, is the dean going to step down?"

Hearing this, Xiao Yin knocked Xiao Luo's forehead directly.

"That's called retirement."

Xiao Luo immediately covered his forehead and sucked in a cold air, "Yes, yes, retire."

At this time, the three of them were in the outer courtyard of the academy.

Although it is still Tiandi Academy.

But the resources of the outer courtyard are naturally not as good as those of the inner courtyard, and there are not many strong people in the outer courtyard.

There may not even be even a strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

And a terrifying existence like Xiao Yin, who is at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, not to mention in the Tiandi Academy, even if it is placed in the entire fairyland, it is one of the best peerless masters.

At that time, if Xiao Yin wanted to be the vice president, An Lingyun had to consider it.

So now, Xiao Yin can basically walk sideways in Tiandi Academy.

However, at this moment, several passing figures suddenly noticed Xiao Yin and the other two.

After hesitating for a while, the few people walked towards the three of them.

Seeing the person in charge, Xiao Luo's face suddenly became cold.

Xiao Yin, who was standing beside him, noticed Xiao Luo's face and said nothing, but just looked at the people walking towards him silently.

"Xiao Luo, can you come back?"

The young man in the lead looked at Xiao Luo with a sarcastic look on his face.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo said in a deep voice: "Ye Teng, what do you mean?!"

"What does it mean? Hahaha, don't you know what your Xiao clan is now in?"

Obviously, the young man in front of him was not clear about the current situation of the Xiao clan.

To be precise, only those extremely strong people in the entire Tiandi Academy know the current situation of the Xiao clan.

It will take some time for the news to reach this point.

Seeing Xiao Luo not speaking, the young man named Ye Teng continued, "What, I'm telling you?"

"I guess now, you Xiao clan is gone."

"Hahaha."

Ye Teng did not hide his smile and laughed out loud.

Because, he is a member of the Leaf clan, one of the four ancient families.

Seeing Ye Teng laughing here, Xiao Luo had a blank expression, including Xiao Yin and Lu Xue beside him.

At this time, a man with a stingy face behind Ye Teng suddenly came to Ye Teng's ears, and then looked at Xiao Yin and Lu Xue beside Xiao Luo with malicious intentions.

After a while, Ye Teng turned his head slightly to look at Xiao Yin and Lu Xue, his expression suddenly became slightly shocked.

"I really didn't expect that even your Xiao clan had not fallen to this point and was almost exterminated. You can still get such a beautiful woman, but there are still two."

Ye Teng looked sour and said to Xiao Yin and Lu Xue without any concealment: "Two beauties, don't be deceived by him. The Xiao clan behind him has been unable to do it for a long time, and now they are probably destroyed. Then, I can't get any benefits with him."

Then Ye Teng pointed at himself again, and said arrogantly: "I am a member of the ancient Ye tribe. Follow me, I promise to make you feel comfortable in the academy."

But at this time, Xiao Luo was already furious.

"Ye Teng! What are you farting?!"

Are Xiao Yin and Lu Xue their own women? He didn't dare to give himself ten thousand courage!

One is the clan sister I have always admired, and the other, if I dare to touch a hair, the other father will probably just let his soul go away and he will never be able to reincarnate.

Thinking of this, Xiao Luo's anger became deeper.

But in Ye Teng's opinion, he felt that Xiao Luo was poked in pain, and the smile on his face became stronger.

"Don't call me, now you can't live anymore. If you give these two women to me, I can consider accepting you as my subordinate. At that time, maybe the strong men of my clan can spare you. How about a life?”

Ye Teng was still immersed in his fantasy at this moment.

Once a genius knelt down and a peerless beauty lay in her arms.

Wonderful, wonderful.

"Sister Xiao Yin, why do there still be such people in Tiandi Academy?"

At this time, Lu Xue whispered in confusion at Xiao Yin.

Because Ye Teng gave her the impression that she was so stupid, she didn't look like a scholar at all.

Even the few dog legs beside him.

Isn’t Tiandi Academy a holy place to study? How could this happen?

Hearing Lu Xue’s question, Xiao Yin said helplessly: “There will be some stains everywhere, and Tiandi Academy is no exception.”

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded clearly.

In the eyes of the two girls, Ye Teng was just a clown, and he didn't take it seriously at all.

It's just an ant that can be killed with snatches.

Only Xiao Luo is now angry about it.

At this moment, Xiao Luo was so angry that he was trembling all over, and he was obviously about to take action directly.

Seeing this, Xiao Yin shook his head helplessly.

Xiao Luo's mentality still needs exercise.

"Ye Teng, right? From today on, you will be expelled from the Tiandi Academy."

Looking at the arrogant Ye Teng in front of him, Xiao Yin said expressionlessly.

When Ye Teng heard this, he was stunned and then laughed.

The dog legs behind him also laughed.

"Beauty, do you want me to laugh to death? Who do you think you are?"

Regarding this, Xiao Yin did not talk nonsense and took out the token of the instructor of the inner courtyard, "Do you recognize this?"

Seeing the token in Xiao Yin's hand, the few dogs were still laughing wildly.

"You want to fool us with a toy. You think we are stupid,"

Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Ye Teng.

At this moment, Ye Teng looked at the token in Xiao Yin's hand with a serious expression.

As a member of the ancient Leaf clan, he still has the knowledge he should have.

With just a glance, he could see the authenticity of the token.

"You, are you a tutor in the inner courtyard?!"

Ye Teng looked at Xiao Yin with shock and said.

Even if he beat him to death, he would never have thought that a beautiful woman he met in the outer courtyard would be a mentor in the inner courtyard next to Xiao Luo.

Each of the inner tutors of Tiandi Academy is a powerful existence, with no more than ten in total.

But now there is an inner courtyard tutor standing in front of him.

"Teacher, yes, sorry, the students don't know."
